ISS-016.title: chat streaming route drops first generated token via bogus prompt-prefix strip
ISS-016.details: chat.py:_chat_stream_generator uses 'if not prompt_sent and prompt.startswith(token): continue' to strip a prompt echo, but no backend's stream() echoes the prompt (EagerGenerationBackend.stream -> eager.stream_generate yields only generated tokens; BatchedGenerationBackend.stream -> engine.stream_request yields only generated ids). Only generate() prepends prompt. So a legitimate generated first token that happens to be a prefix of the rendered prompt string (e.g. first char 'u' matching prompt 'user: hi\nAssistant: ') is silently dropped from the SSE stream. Repro: FakeService yielding ['u','sually...',' done'] with prompt 'user: hi...' streams back ['sually...',' done'] — 'u' lost. Real eager backend confirmed stream()==generated-only.

ISS-019.title: GPTQ act_order + group quantization misaligns dequantization scales
ISS-019.details: _gptq py quantize() permutes w at line ~208 (w = w[:, perm]) and never un-permutes w before computing per-group scales at ~287-303; q_out is un-permuted back to original column order (q_out[:, invperm]). scales then indexed by permuted group order while q_out is original order. Downstream _quantize_linear_with_gptq multiplies q_out by scales.repeat_interleave, applying wrong group scale to columns whose permutation crossed a group boundary. Empirically: 13/20 columns change groups under perm. Reconstruction error worse with act_order=True (0.29 vs 0.20).
